thread:
maya: FYI nightly fusion/perf job flagged a regression on the 'paged-flash' path for long sequences (4096). ~18% throughput drop vs yesterday :eyes:
leo: I reproduced locally. It happens when the KV cache grows >~512 chunks and the batch merger triggers tiled kernel selection. Kernel selector flips to fused_fallback for some batches and throughput tanks.
anya: do you have the flame/profile snippet? might be helpful to see where time goes.
maya: pasted high-level numbers: ```summary: baseline (flash-v1, no paging) seq=512 -> 1.2k toks/s; paged-flash seq=4096 -> 980 toks/s; fused-fallback seq=4096 -> 720 toks/s; overall nightly delta: -18%```
ci-bot: CI alert: perf/regression >10% on eng-runtime/nightly (job id: 8742).
nathan: my guess: numeric instability when we switch kernels and concurrently do fp8->fp16 casts for softmax. If exp() sees large positive logits due to missed scaling, fp8 path can overflow and trigger branch to 'stable-softmax' which changes kernel selection.
leo: we see occasional NaNs coming from softmax stage in the fused path. Example stack from logs: ```attn_fused_kern.cu: line 432 exp overflow -> nan```
anya: did we change quant scale recently? last week I tweaked kv quant scale heuristics for smaller memory footprint. Maybe scale gets too big for long contexts.
maya: repro script: ```python repro_long.py --model=open --seq=4096 --kv-page-size=64 --quant=fp8 --batch-merge=on``` gives flaky nans within 10-30 iterations.
nathan: quick mitigation: clamp logits before exp, e.g. logits = max(logits, logits.max(dim=-1)[0] - 64) or cast to fp16 before exp. That stabilizes numerics but the cast adds ~3-5% perf cost.
leo: tried clamp -64, it removes NaNs but kernel selector still flips mid-epoch because of slightly different latency profile; causes jitter and throughput variance. We need hysteresis in selector.
athan: agree — propose selector hysteresis: require % change > 12% sustained over 3 consecutive batches before switching. Also add metric for numeric errors (NaN counts) to force stable kernel.
anya: another note: KV paged rehydrate path had a dtype mismatch where bf16 pages are being read into an fp8 cache buffer on a rare path. Added assert and saw reproduction. Looks like page rehydrate path didn't cast when cache format changed after rollout.
maya: good catch. that explains occasional memory corruption -> NaNs. I pushed a small guard in local tree to cast on rehydrate.
ci-bot: perf job queued for rerun with patch maya/kvcache-rehydrate-guard.
athan: long-term: add a kernel-selection cost model that includes numeric-safety penalty (i.e., if kernel historically produced NaNs on similar inputs, penalize score). Also include sequence-length distribution and kv-chunk counts as inputs.
leo: plan: (1) add repro in perf/repros, (2) add numeric-safety metric in telemetry, (3) implement hysteresis config, (4) revert risky fp8 quant rollout until stable. Assigning to eng-runtime oncall.
maya: I'll open issue ENGRT-1482 with logs, repro, and the perf flame.
anya: optional: consider microkernel that does fp16 softmax but fp8 matmul to preserve throughput/precision tradeoff. Might be a good middle ground.
nathan: :thumbsup: I'll prototype softmax-cast microkernel tomorrow.
leo: tagging @oncall for visibility.
ops-bot: ticket ENGRT-1482 created by maya.
maya: thanks all. will follow up once CI rerun finishes. :pray:
